title: On the Generation Order in GFlowNets
abstract: arXiv:2610.41648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling from discrete distributions specified by unnormalised probability functions is a classical statistical problem. GFlowNets address this problem by constructing objects sequentially, adding one discrete component at a time in either a predefined or a learned order. The choice of order determines which conditional distributions the neural network must learn, some of which may be easier to learn than others. Yet whether existing GFlowNet algorithms discover interpretable generation orders and make use of them during training remains unexplored. We introduce controlled problems where generation order is experimentally shown to affect convergence and standard GFlowNet training struggles to discover useful orders. To address this difficulty, we develop Learning-Order GFlowNet, a training recipe that learns interpretable generation orders without order annotations and improves convergence on these problems. translated_abstract: 从由未归一化概率函数所指定的离散分布中进行采样是一个经典的统计问题。GFlowNets通过顺序构建对象来解决这一问题，即按照预定义或学习到的顺序每次添加一个离散组件。顺序的选择决定了神经网络需要学习哪些条件分布，而其中一些条件分布可能比其他的更容易学习。然而，现有GFlowNet算法是否能发现可解释的生成顺序并在训练过程中加以利用，这一问题尚待探索。我们引入了若干受控问题，实验表明生成顺序会影响收敛性，且标准GFlowNet训练难以发现有用的顺序。为了解决这一困难，我们提出了Learning-Order GFlowNet，这是一种训练方法，能够在没有顺序标注的情况下学习可解释的生成顺序，并在这些问题上改善收敛性。最后，我们研究了梯度……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出Learning-Order GFlowNet训练方法，无需顺序标注即可自动学习可解释的生成顺序，从而改善GFlowNet在生成顺序影响收敛的问题上的训练效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Learning-Order GFlowNet, a training recipe that learns interpretable generation orders without order annotations, improving convergence on problems where the generation order affects GFlowNet training.
